en.tagline: Generate AI videos from text, images and references
en.summary: This skill runs AI video models from the command line through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, lipsync, avatars, video editing, upscaling and sound effects, with 40+ models such as Veo, Seedance, Kling, Wan and HappyHorse.
problem: Each video model has its own app ID, input fields and limits. Choosing one and getting its input right takes time when you only want a clip for a post, ad or demo.
With this skill, you pick an app ID from the model tables, pass a JSON input with `belt app run`, and get the video back. Changing models means changing the app ID and the input fields.
fit: Social media clips and short marketing videos
Animating a still image or making a talking-head video from a portrait and audio
unfit: You cannot use the inference.sh CLI (`belt`), since every run goes through it
You need image generation or text-to-speech only, which other skills cover
steps: Pick a model from the tables by task, such as text-to-video, image-to-video or lipsync.
Run it with `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`, using the prompt, image, video or audio fields that model expects.
Use the optional fields in the examples, such as `duration`, `resolution` or `generate_audio`, to control length, quality and sound.
Chain tools when needed, for example adding sound with `infsh/mmaudio` or merging clips with `infsh/media-merger`.
List other video apps with `belt app list --category video`.

zh.tagline: 用文字、图片和参考图生成 AI 视频
zh.summary: 这个 skill 通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具调用 AI 视频模型。它支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、口型同步、数字人、视频编辑、超分和音效，覆盖 Veo、Seedance、Kling、Wan、HappyHorse 等 40 多个模型。
problem: 每个视频模型的应用 ID、输入字段和限制都不一样。如果只想为一条帖子、广告或演示做一段视频，选模型并写对输入会花不少时间。
用了这个 skill，你从模型表中选一个应用 ID，用 `belt app run` 传入 JSON 输入，就能拿到视频。换模型只需要改应用 ID 和输入字段。
fit: 社交媒体短视频和营销视频
让静态图片动起来，或用人像和音频做说话人视频
unfit: 无法使用 inference.sh 命令行工具（`belt`），因为所有调用都经过它
只需要图片生成或文本转语音，这些由其他 skill 负责
steps: 按任务从模型表中选模型，例如文生视频、图生视频或口型同步。
用 `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'` 运行，传入该模型需要的提示词、图片、视频或音频字段。
按需加入示例中的可选字段，如 `duration`、`resolution` 或 `generate_audio`，控制时长、清晰度和声音。
需要时串联其他工具，例如用 `infsh/mmaudio` 加音效，或用 `infsh/media-merger` 合并片段。
用 `belt app list --category video` 查看其他视频应用。
